'''2016 Endor Grand Prix''' was a Players Committee major event in Seattle, Washington, 20–22 May 2016. [[Brian Fred]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-endor-grand-prix/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Seattle, Washington
* '''Dates:''' 20–22 May 2016
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Fred]]
